versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Dynamics Partner Advisor skill.
- Search, compare, and shortlist Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementation partners by product, industry, and region.
- Connects directly to the live Top Dynamics Partners database via Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Offers tools for partner search, detailed partner profiles, and AI-powered shortlist recommendations.
- No local dependencies; requires an MCP-compatible agent to use.
